LanguageData.CS_BurnedGodMetal_Lerasium: {PAWN} consumes the god metal. In an instant, their spirit web reshapes — all paths of Allomancy now lie open.
LanguageData.CS_BurnedGodMetal_Atium: {PAWN} consumes the god metal. They can now catch glimpses of other pawns futures! Use it wisely...
LanguageData.CS_BurnedGodMetal_Leratium: {PAWN} consumes the god metal. Their spirit web reshapes around it - every path of Feruchemy now lies open to them.
LanguageData.CS_BurnedGodMetal_LerasiumAlloy: {PAWN} consumes the alloy. The lerasium in it opens one path of Allomancy, and closes the rest forever.
LanguageData.CS_BurnedGodMetal_LeratiumAlloy: {PAWN} consumes the alloy. The leratium in it opens one path of Feruchemy, and closes the rest forever.
